title: Per-job lost reason is queried on the keeper's connection inside the single loop
notes: When several jobs are found lost in one renewal, attempt() calls j.lost for each in turn, each bounded by half a heartbeat on the keeper's connection. With k lost jobs and a slow database, the keeper's next renewal for the other jobs is delayed by up to k half-heartbeats. The cut timers still protect the lease. Alternative: fetch the reasons in one query or afterwards, off the renewal path. Closed at the pivot: Rule 17: says nothing a viewer or operator would notice (a test's strength, a refactor, tooling or an internal cost). Reopen with the effect someone sees and its evidence.
